inputs.original_text: SSANU’s 54th National Executive Council has given the government one month to address the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement, with an indefinite nationwide strike on the table. This seems like more than a simple failure to reach a deal: keeping workers waiting and universities under pressure serves someone, while a strike threat could make workers convenient public scapegoats and keep those benefiting from the delay out of sight.
